title: Check regression discrimination in every claimed dtype and path
applies_when: A padding, masked-content or warm-cache regression test compares paired outputs across FP16/BF16 dtypes or execution paths, especially when a broad numerical tolerance can hide the defect.
lesson: Execution success and regression discrimination are different evidence. Run identical test bytes on the known-bad parent and repair, and inspect each claimed affected dtype/path separately; legitimate unchanged controls may pass in both. Establish the real consumer contract before changing assertions. For deterministic paired calls where only ignored masked content differs, exact output invariance can be appropriate even when kernel/reference comparisons need tolerances. In FLA SimpleGLA PR #1273, real RTX5090 layer/Triton calls gave parent 2 failed/2 passed and candidate 4 passed: both BF16 regressions already passed at tolerance 0.02. Repeating the same constructions with paired torch.equal made all four regressions fail before and pass after, with exact repaired output invariance; three related caller controls passed after. Use this to assess the oracle, not to manufacture a baseline failure.
avoid_when: Do not require every control or unaffected cell to fail on the parent. Exact paired invariance is not a universal bitwise policy for stochastic calls, gradients, different reduction schedules, kernel/reference comparisons or different devices. This observation covers small SimpleGLA layer cases with use_short_conv=False, not backward, full-model behavior, other backends, performance or overall upstream readiness. Available advice does not demonstrate better Scout conversion or lower total research cost.

evidence.note: The exact PR tests cover interior padding and warm-cache continuation in FP16/BF16 with paired masked-content perturbations. These source bytes define the cases, not independent GPU execution evidence.

Independent real-layer/Triton validation of exact head 5fd4d711 against parent 954438d1 on RTX5090, Torch 2.11.0+cu130, Triton 3.6.0 and Python 3.12.13. Original BF16 checks pass before repair despite relative errors 0.008699/0.014372; deterministic paired equality discriminates all four cells. No monkeypatch, performance or full-suite claim.
